commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha' hb' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a' ⬝ b', .refl _, .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      obtain ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha' ha''
      obtain ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb' hb''
      exact ⟨a₃ ⬝ b₃, .par ha.1 hb.1, .par ha.2 hb.2⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha']
      exact ⟨b', .red_I b', .refl b'⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨a₂', ha₂'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha'
      rw [ha₂'.2]
      exact ⟨a₂', .red_K a₂' b', ha₂'.1⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      obtain ⟨a'', c', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha'
      rw [h.2.2]
      exact ⟨a'' ⬝ b' ⬝ (c' ⬝ b'), .red_S a'' c' b',
        .par (.par h.1 (ParallelReduction.refl b'))
          (.par h.2.1 (ParallelReduction.refl b'))⟩
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl a₁, .red_I a₁⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      exact ⟨a₁', ha, .red_I a₁'⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨a₁, .refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl a₁, .red_K a₁ c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      obtain ⟨a₁', h'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      rw [h'.2]
      exact ⟨a₁', h'.1, .red_K a₁' c'⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨a₁, .refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨a', b', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [h.2.2]
      exact ⟨a' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b' ⬝ c'),
        .par (.par h.1 hc) (.par h.2.1 hc), .red_S ..⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _⟩
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
p='candidate.lean'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"exact ⟨b', .red_I b', .refl b'⟩\",\"exact ⟨b', .red_I b', hb'⟩\")
s=s.replace(\".par (.par h.1 (ParallelReduction.refl b'))\\n          (.par h.2.1 (ParallelReduction.refl b'))\", \".par (.par h.1 hb') (.par h.2.1 hb')\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
